s.how: Arrange 250g hummus, 200g olives and 200g feta drizzled with oil on a platter. Warm 4 flatbreads and cut into wedges. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

Mix 100g oats, 150g flour, 80g coconut and 120g brown sugar. Melt 125g butter with 2 tbsp golden syrup, add 1 tsp bicarb in 2 tbsp boiling water and stir through. Roll balls and bake at 170C for 12 minutes.

m.note: dinner at the hotel in Istanbul
m.how: Mix 600g lamb mince with grated onion, cumin, paprika and parsley and shape onto skewers. Grill 8 minutes, turning. Serve with 200g yoghurt, tomato and onion salad and 4 flatbreads.

w.how: Layer 12 sheets filo brushed with 150g melted butter and 250g chopped walnuts and pistachios. Cut diamonds and bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Pour over a syrup of 200g honey, 100g sugar and lemon.

d.how: Brew strong coffee in a small pot and serve in little cups. Steep apple tea bags in boiling water and sweeten for anyone who prefers tea.
